notes.title: v1.017 NOW LIVE!
notes.content:
Hello there! Delighted to announce I've been secretly storing up all the bugs that got reported over the last couple of months for one big boring update. 

With this, the game is now (as far as I'm aware) BUG FREE again so if you're playing it and you're like "hey, hang on a second, THIS IS A BUG!" it means you're very clever and please email full details to dan@sizefivegames.com asap so I can fix it.

DISCLAIMER: That said, I have not yet fixed the one where Dan clips into the floor if you jump onto Ben's head. It's something to do with the physics. Will have another look at it asap.

Here's the full list of changes: 

- Hopefully fixed an issue where the game could hang when you're mopping a floor
- Added a custom control map for SwitchPro controllers, which didn't play nice natively
- Teleporting while shifting gravity should no longer cause things to stay wibbly.
- Teleporting at an inopportune moment during the ending no longer causes issues
- Fixed an issue that could cause a camera to lock on the final boss
- Hopefully fixed an issue where Dan could fall off a critical water spurt (thanks Tony!)
- Improved framerate across all systems (thanks Tony!)
- Fixed Chapter Select to the last chapter being borked (thanks Tony!)
- Your inventory should no longer be full if you start a new game immediately after completing the game.
- Like, some extremely minor pissy shit

Hope you've enjoyed the game. If you have PLEASE PLEASE REVIEW IT. We need as many ace reviews as we can, so please take a second to let other people know you enjoyed the game.

Thanks!

Dan

notes.title: v1.016 Now Live
notes.content:
Hello! I'm aware it's been a few weeks since the last update - bugs are now coming in so infrequently that daily updates no longer really make sense, so I'm saving them all up for larger patches.


- Linux version now has a 64-bit version available
- Fixed an issue where skipping Splash screens with a gamepad caused the 'Save warting' dialogue to be missed
- Fixed missing characters in the dyslexic-friendly font option
- Accessing the top bit of a boat is now way easier
- Fixed an issue where starting a conversation the instant a lift started to move caused Camera Issues
- Fixed some potentially-sticky ice
- Fixed some extraordinarily minor typos

As always, if you find a bug please let me know at dan@sizefivegames.com, rather than leaving messages in places I might not see them.

If you've enjoyed Lair of the Clockwrok God but haven't yet REVIEWED it on Steam, please please do take a second to do that right now. It really helps me out.

Hope you're staying home and safe during these weird times.

Best,

Dan
